subject: how to use geom_rect to add background layer corresponding to its scale axis

messages.author: 734687dc847d1db0
messages.subject: how to use geom_rect to add background layer corresponding to its scale axis
parts:
Dear all,

Hello! I'm pretty new to ggtree packages but found it fantastic to generate great figure so I really would like to use it more!

I have BEAST output and would like to visualize the MCC tree using ggtree. I would like to add background striped pattern that corresponds to the tree's scale axis (in my case, time scale of MCC tree) just like the Figure 5 from Su, Y. C. F. et al. Phylodynamics of H1N1/2009 influenza reveals the transition from host adaptation to immune-driven selection. Nat. Commun. 6:7952 doi: 10.1038/ncomms8952 (2015).

I'm trying to do it by adding geom_rect layer with following command:

   g <- ggtree(my_MCC, aes(color=location, mrsd="2015-01-01") +
             theme_tree2() +
             scale_color_brewer("location", palette = "Spectral")

   g <-  geom_rect(my_MCC$data$x, aes(xmin=1925, xmax=1950, ymin=-Inf, y=Inf, color="grey", alpha=.5)) +
           geom_rect(my_MCC$data$x, aes(xmin=1975, xmax=2000, ymin=-Inf, y=Inf, color="grey", alpha=.5)) + g

  
But I got the error message: 'data' must be a data frame, or other object coercible by 'fortify()', not numeric vector

I tried to covered my data using fortify() function but still keep getting same error. I searched about this issue on Google but could not find the right answer.

Could anybody can help me out how to solve this?

Best,

Shusuke
